tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mthu stobs dpung skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur/ khyab bdag rigs mchog drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// gsang bdag rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs// mthu stobs dpung skyed dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gtsug lag dpal dge ba/ khrag 'thung nag po shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i zhabs// ba su dhā ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mthu stobs dpung skyed dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// rgyal kun stobs bcu gcig 'dus o rgyan rje// dbyings phyug ye shes ḍā ki mtsho rgyal ma// sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mthu stobs dpung skyed dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ lo chen bai ro khri srong dam 'dzin rje// mchog gyur gling pa las can chos kyi bdag /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ mthu stobs dpung skyed dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ 'jam dpal rdo rje phyag rgya zil gnon sogs// gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// chos srung bka' sdod bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ mthu stobs dpung skyed dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ smin byed dbang chus gtor blugs mtha' ru phyin// lam gyi rim pas bskyed rdzogs drod tshad rnyed// 'khor 'das kun khyab 'jam dpal ye shes sems// gtan la pheb nas don gnyis lhun grub shog /snang grags phyag rgya zil gyis gnon par rdzogs// gzung 'dzin mdud pa 'od gsal gzhi thog grol// las bzhi'i 'khor los snang srid dbang du sgyur// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzi ldan shog /srung ba'i go cha rdo rje'i rdzong chen thob// zlog pa'i gnam thog phas rgol snying la 'beb// bsad pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhing bcu'i dus chen po// mngon spyod mthu yis sa gsum g.yo bar shog /brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag rig stong 'jam pa'i dpal// 'gro ba kun gyi snying la rab sad nas// mun pa'i 'jigs bcom ye shes snang ba ches// gnas lugs rgyal sa myur bar mthong gyur cig

ces pa 'di'ang chos 'di'i bdag por lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob pa yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyis de bī ko ṭi gsum pa dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
